item.title: The Batman Part 2's Mystery Villains May Have Just Been Confirmed in Major Leak
item.description: Several newcomers were confirmed for The Batman Part 2 's cast over the summer, including Sebastian Stan, Scarlett Johansson, Brian Tyree Henry, and Charles Dance. Their roles in the DC film haven't been confirmed yet, though that hasn't stopped the speculation. Rumors pointed to Stan playing the serial killer Victor Zsasz while Stan himself seemingly confirmed he'd be playing Harvey Dent in an interview with the French outlet Le Journal du Dimanche . (That article has since been updated, and the mention of Harvey Dent removed from it.) Now, it seems like Heidi Klum's Halloween costume team has confirmed Stan and Henry's roles in The Batman Part 2 .

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company’s Cast Talks About That Huge Order 66 Moment
item.description: Order 66 and the Great Jedi Purge have been depicted in various Star Wars media, like Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order and Star Wars: The Bad Batch . Bit Reactor’s beloved strategy game Star Wars Zero Company has its own huge Order 66 moment.

item.title: BioWare Fan Creates a Graveyard of Shut Down Studios at EA Offices
item.description: The gaming community has become increasingly disgruntled with EA over the past few years. Shutting down BioWare , the beloved development studio behind Mass Effect, was the straw that broke the camel's back, causing an uproar on social media platforms and leading some fans to take action in the real world.

item.title: 23 Years Later, Gandalf’s Greatest Lord of the Rings Line Is Still the Wisest Quote in Fantasy History
item.description: Peter Jackson’s epic adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien’s The Lord of the Rings trilogy features a massive cast, with many characters delivering at least one incredibly poetic line across the films. Honestly, is there any line more heartbreaking than Boromir’s anguished “I would have followed you, my brother, my captain, my king”?

item.title: Yakuza Creator's Studio Officially Shuts Down After Backers Desert It
item.description: Nagoshi Studio, the developer founded by Yakuza creator Toshihiro Nagoshi, has officially closed its doors after backer NetEase stopped its funding . Nagoshi Studio had been working on Gang of Dragon , a Yakuza-style crime drama starring Ma Dong-seok.

item.title: Elon Musk Officially Confirms He Doesn't Get Star Wars
item.description: Elon Musk, owner of Tesla and SpaceX, and an avid Grok advocate , has never been shy about expressing his opinion online. He had plenty to say about award-winning director Christopher Nolan's wildly successful adaptation of The Odyssey — including claiming an AI-influenced reimagining of the series would be "true to the art of Homer" — and even more on the finale of Amazon's gritty superhero series, The Boys .

item.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
item.description: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid. Especially since these goodies don't actually require a successful extraction to obtain them.

item.title: 'Calvin and Hobbes' Best Babysitter Quote Is Still Among the Funniest in Comic Strip History
item.description: Batman has the Joker, Superman has Lex Luthor, Captain America has the Red Skull, and for six-year-old Calvin, his avowed arch-nemesis is Rosalyn, the diabolical babysitter who makes him go to bed at 6:30.

item.title: Forget ‘Crystal Lake,’ the Best Action Thriller in TV History Remains Unbeaten 29 Years Later
item.description: Crystal Lake has been dominating the streaming charts. Over the past week, the series became Peacock’s fourth most-watched scripted original. It inspired hundreds of online videos analyzing its twists and turns, and reminded the world of the everlasting magic of Linda Cardellini.
